appearance.subtle: They blink slightly out of time with themselves.
appearance.obvious: A clear second lid sweeps sideways across their eyes and back.
appearance.extreme: Their eyes are permanently half-shuttered behind a sliding grey film, and they walk into a dust storm without squinting.

description: A second eyelid that closes sideways. Dust, smoke, grit and chemical spray have all stopped being your problem.
name: Nictitating Membrane
